Warning: this engine runs without a sandbox

%1$s has no sandboxed runtime yet. Run it anyway and its code has Enginehost\'s own access while it runs: it can read and write anything on shared storage and use the network, the same as the app itself. We recommend not installing cores that cannot run sandboxed. This is asked every time; nothing is remembered.
Warning: this core can\'t run sandboxed

%1$s can\'t run in Enginehost\'s sandbox. While a game plays, its code has Enginehost\'s own access: it can read and write anything on shared storage and use the network. We recommend not installing cores that cannot run sandboxed.
Which apps can launch a game
Enginehost can be asked by any app to launch a game (that is the point of it). Decide here which apps may do that with no prompt, which are refused outright, and which are asked about each time.
